title: Pressure Storage Tank
model_title: Spherical Pressure Storage Tank (Horton Sphere) for LPG/Butane

introduction.definition: A spherical pressure tank (Horton sphere) stores liquefied gases such as propane and butane under pressure. A sphere carries internal pressure with the least wall thickness for its volume. It stands on columns at the equator with bracing, with relief valves, deluge and level instruments.
applications: LPG and butane storage at refineries/terminals

foundation: Individual column footings with settlement monitoring; fireproof the legs.
alignment: Check verticality (vertical vessels) or level and slope (horizontal); one saddle bolted, the other slotted for thermal expansion.
piping: Connect nozzles without forcing — check allowable nozzle loads; support piping independently.
Fit the required pressure relief device and isolation as per code.
commissioning: Hydro/pneumatic test per code; inspect internals before closing; purge and leak test; commission instruments and relief valves.

lubrication: No lubrication — static equipment (lubricate valve stems and manway hinges only).

video_tutorials.title: Pressure Storage Tank — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Pressure Storage Tank.
A spherical pressure tank (Horton sphere) stores liquefied gases such as propane and butane under pressure.
A sphere carries internal pressure with the least wall thickness for its volume.
It stands on columns at the equator with bracing, with relief valves, deluge and level instruments.
Typical applications include LPG and butane storage at refineries/terminals; ammonia (refrigerated/pressurised); hydrogen and gas buffers.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Pressure Storage Tank works.
Liquefied gas is stored with vapour above it.
Liquid leaves from the bottom nozzle.
Relief valves at the top protect against overpressure.
Columns and bracing carry the weight; deluge cools in a fire.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Pressure Storage Tank.
Check level and pressure.
Test relief valves and deluge.
Internal inspection (wet fluorescent MT of welds).
Watch for weld cracking: indications in NDT. Common cause: stress corrosion, fatigue.
Watch for leg fire damage: collapse risk. Common cause: missing fireproofing.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
